name: al-agentic-dev
description:
Agentic AL/Business Central development: composable skills (al-steer, al-grill-adr, al-event-model, al-design, al-scope, al-refine, al-implement, al-refactor, al-code-review, al-mutate, al-second-opinion, al-research) with two persistent layers: repo-root memory (CONTEXT.md, docs/adr/, .out-of-scope/) and branch-scoped feature state (event-model.html + architecture.html + tasks.html). SKILLs express intent and rationale, not enumerated rules with skip conditions or slot prescriptions; disciplines (deletion test, two-adapter rule, R→P→W, ZOMBIES, replan triggers) state why they exist and the agent maps rationale to situation per feature. NEW in 0.23.0: chat reports land at BC app altitude via a new Gate report shape in references/user-communication.md. Replaces Per-bullet (T-NNN#K + Given/When/Then + RED/GREEN tables + build counts) and Close (mechanical Bullets/Refactor/Mutations/Status/Commit/Next ready table), both demoted to superseded notes with bodies preserved as anti-patterns. Discipline is intent prose, not a slot template: four answers reached in natural prose when they apply (what user-facing behavior the change enables in BC user language, the problem it solves with a concrete scenario, how the change fits the app at module/pattern/seam altitude, the user's call). Implementation mechanics (procedure names, line numbers, mutant IDs, lens findings, build counts, AL Runner verdicts) move out of chat and into commits, tasks.html, and .out-of-scope/ where the audit trail belongs. Per-skill cadence inline in each gate-style SKILL.md as a one-section "## Gate event" statement (al-implement per scenario; al-refine per task; al-design/event-model/scope per feature; al-mutate and al-refactor standalone-only since they fold into /al-implement; al-code-review per finding decision via auto-grill loop; al-steer per user question). Sub-skills inside /al-implement (al-refactor, al-mutate) emit no own report; findings fold into the scenario's Gate report. Conversational/pass-through skills (al-grill-adr, al-second-opinion, al-research) skipped: different output shapes. NEW in 0.22.0: /al-code-review post-filter findings auto-feed into a per-finding /grill-me triage loop. No manual 'Run /grill-me' handoff sentence; no pre-dumped finding bodies, suppressed-for-transparency block, or lens-zero prose on screen. Chrome-only chat output: one-line opener + 3-row scope chip (Scope/Baseline/Findings), one-line progress chip between grills, 3-row closer summary (new tasks/notes/dropped). Severity-then-confidence ordering (correctness > performance > hygiene). Each grill receives a pre-transformed triage proposal (finding body + lens 'Recommended next' as the plan to stress-test) plus the three-outcome contract: land one of {new task, note on existing future task, drop}, write to tasks.html, exit. Zero findings skips the loop with one line; abort = partial summary, no resume, untriaged dropped (transient by design); single-finding case skips the progress chip. grill-me itself stays generic - the triage contract rides in via spawn prompt, not via SKILL.md changes to grill-me. Out-of-scope item 'No auto-grilling' removed (its rationale was wrong: the manual keypress added no judgement, only friction; per-finding judgement happens inside each grill, which the loop preserves). NEW in 0.21.0: voice-contract.md gains the *Artifacts get scanned, not slow-read* intent. Dense `

` walls in artifact bodies (task descriptions, callout bodies, table cells) are named as the failure shape; the reader scans landing points top to bottom and slow-reads one block. Multi-fact passage → one fact per landing line; container (bullets, sub-callouts, table rows, sub-`

`, separate paragraphs) is the writing skill's call per content. Voice scope rows for description and alert body collapsed to a single row deferring to the intent. /al-scope's Description section and design-system Density rule harmonized. NEW in 0.20.0: /al-code-review and /al-refactor both restructured to lens-parallel sub-agent pattern (mirrors native /code-review). /al-code-review spawns 4 lenses per-task (project compliance vs CONTEXT.md + ADRs + architecture.html + Gherkin, shallow bug scan, BC-specific via bc-knowledge at relevance >= 50, code comments + git history) and 5 per-feature (adds AppSource public-surface addition lock-in, the one cross-file concern linters miss since CodeCop/AppSourceCop catch removal not addition); then a Haiku-equivalent confidence pass filters findings to >= 80 before /grill-me triage. /al-refactor spawns 4 lenses (simplify/dedup primary, BC-specific best practices via bc-knowledge at >= 70, structural shape via R->P->W/depth/seams, naming via BC vocabulary + project terminology check against CONTEXT.md/ADRs/architecture.html/event-model.html), then applies changes one at a time with /al-build between. Shared bc-knowledge call pattern in plugin-level references/bc-knowledge-dispatch.md with topic caching note and known-limitation flag on non-Codeunit specialist mappings. Findings stay out of linter territory (AL build pipeline handles it). Never routes via /al-steer. NEW in 0.18.0: Linear-style design system at references/design-system/ becomes the single source of truth for spec artifact visuals (gallery.html + three populated example pages + canonical CSS tokens, Inter Tight + Inter + JetBrains Mono, auto light/dark via prefers-color-scheme, mid-tone Mermaid palette). Per-feature aesthetic divergence is gone; class names, palette, typography, and component shape are prescribed centrally. html-spec-discipline.md rewritten as contracts + tokens summary + design-system pointer. Surgical-edit contracts on tasks.html unchanged. NEW in 0.17.0: /al-event-model settles the user-facing journey (Role / Action / Business Event / View / Status, Event Modeling lineage) before /al-design commits architecture. Optional per feature, pure-backend features skip it. /al-design reads event-model.html and settles AL-shape only; user-side picks no longer re-litigated inline. Branch creation shared between /al-event-model and /al-design (first per-feature skill to run creates the branch). BREAKING in 0.16.0: tasks.html surgical-edit contract collapses from six hooks to two (data-task + data-status only). Every other shape inside the task block is the writing skill's call per task; inconsistency across features is fine and expected. architecture.html has no surgical-edit contract at all. ADRs and CONTEXT.md stay markdown. Legacy markdown specs are frozen; new skills refuse to operate on them. No bilingual dispatch.
